notes.title: No more
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I'm sorry to say this, but I'm going to have to stop working on the game. Something's happened to my backups and after rolling back, some of my core blueprints are refusing to open in the editor. Unreal Engine has way too many bugs for me to keep going forward with a project like this. The Engine is nice for small stuff, but this is way out of its scope. There are solutions to fix these problems, but I'm not sure I want to try anymore. Nobody seems to have any interest in the game and the market is going to be flooded with space sims, sci-fi sandboxes, etc...so starting over wouldn't really make sense.

Thank you to everyone who stuck around and gave me some encouragement. This was a fun process and I learned a lot!

Hey everyone! I just wanted to pop in and show some of the stuff I've been working on since it's been awhile since I've updated you.

The screenshot above is a small Skirmish map I'm working on for the 1.4.0 update. Skirmish is going to be the first new game mode that will be added in the 1.4.0 series. It is a simple death-match inspired game mode where you will be pitted against different players or ai to reach the score limit before time runs out!

Skirmish will be both a standalone game mode, and a quest that can be taken in the Sandbox and other open world areas. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35198270/ef4910f8121caa03db27083fa5ef6fc52e5dc5ae.png[/img]

I'd also like to show off one of the new cities I'm working on for the sandbox!

My goal is to make it feel more 'alive', so these cities will be places where you can find roaming npcs that will go to different buildings and talk with each other, take jobs, etc... and there will be places for you to go and gather side quests, trade, take bounties, buy vehicles and so on!

The 1.4.0 update will also be adding some smaller game modes that I plan on making playable in the open world, such as racing, deathmatches, battle royale, etc...

You'll be able to access them by entering lobbies that create small arenas where the matches will take place. I think this will be a good way to fill up some of the empty space since the planets are beyond massive and extremely empty right now.

I also plan on making it easier to transition from ground to space. Those of you who have played the space sim scenario have probably had a lot of frustration with this already since it can take a very long time to land.

notes.title: 1.3.6 is live on the Unstable branch!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thank you to everyone who has purchased the game so far!

I am still working to resolve all of the issues reported by Genkipro, but I wanted to give you an opportunity to play with the current fixes that I have rolled out.

Moving to the unstable branch might impact your save games, so I would backup your saved directory (contact the support email if you need help) to avoid any data loss. 

The game is in a development build so you might see a few debug messages and you will have access to the console. This could, in some rare cases, cause some performance issues. If the game is slow, try lowering your graphics settings while on the unstable branch. You should be able to raise them back up when you switch back to the stable branch.

The most notable issue, aside from what Genkipro reported, is an issue with the tutorial character's first person camera. I plan to have that fixed and rolled out today, then the build will probably go live!


Again, thank you all for your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: Day Zero 1.0.0!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Day Zero 1.0.0 is finally here!

I promised to release the game as soon as it was ready to release, so I am going to release it tomorrow on 12/20/19!

This update includes a major patch that resolved a lot of the issues with core gameplay mechanics and includes a wide variety of new features and items!

I have updated a lot of the user interfaces to reduce load times and hitches when opening menus. The updates also improve readability and ease of use.

You will also find that the Nexus has been reduced to it's core elements to help improve performance.

There are a couple of Intro quests that have been added to give you some more content while I get Season 2 ready such as Restoring Power to The Nexus, Hiring New Companions, Locating The Void and more!

There are a number of updates included that will help me prepare for the Season 2 update, which will include more features centered around space, , spacecraft, land/air/sea vehicles, fleet building and diplomacy!

One of the biggest additions you will notice is the Unity Network addition which gives you access to a new Journal, Diplomacy and Exploration system while also adding a couple of handy features that will become relevant as I get closer to releasing the Season 2 content.

You will also find a Laptop located in your Personal Quarters that gives you access to the Nexus Manager where you can access a few mini games and extra ways to farm resources without having to grind too hard.

I also went ahead and added a few encoded notes to the Intro level and spread a few around areas that you will find while roaming to get you ready for some of the Season 2 exploration features!

Thank you again for your continued support! I am so excited to finally be able to release the game so you can send your feedback!

notes.title: 0.8.0 - RPG Elements!
notes.notes:
0.8.0 is here! 

The new update brings some new RPG elements to the game that will help bring you closer to Day Zero's story-line and it's impact on the rest of the Universe.

The companion system has been revamped to make it easier for users to build their team and conquer the solar system. 

The Nexus is back with a ton of new rooms that contain NPCs waiting to be convinced to join your adventure!

NPCs will now have unique dialogue options and side quests that will give you the ability to unlock unique items, weapons and story options!

I've also updated the market system to make it easier to sort and browse items, and the new wallet system makes it easier for you to track your assets and different currency types.

The racing system is back with multiple tiers and prizes! 

0.9.0 will bring a lot of bug fixes, adjustments, and a ton of new items! This will roll us into the 1.0.0 update that will include all of the Campaign elements!

notes.title: State of Day Zero
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

I wanted to drop in and let you know that Day Zero is still doing awesome!

There are a couple of bugs with the building system that need to be addressed, and I still need to test some things before I push the game back to the Steam team for the review process. 

Once I have those things fleshed out I'll be ready to release! 

I don't want to give a hard deadline as there could be an unforseen issue that sets us back like before, but I am feeling good about where the code is and where we are going to be able to go with the game in the future.  

We have just entered version 0.7.0, and I will have more patch notes up soon, but for now we are really just dealing with bugfixes and minor weapon/item additions. I don't have any new features planned until the game is released and I've had a chance to get your feedback

Thank you all so much for being so supportive during this setback. It broke my heart to have to delay the game again but, thanks to all of the awesome supporters I have, I haven't (and won't) give up until you have an opportunity to enter the Oculus!

notes.title: Delays
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

It's been awhile since I've posted anything, so I wanted to drop in and let you know that everything is okay!

I'm working on some better tutorials to make sure everyone is able to get access to all of the features the game has to offer. 

There have also been some major updates to the UI which has taken most of my time since I am designing most of the UI assets and materials from scratch.

I've also been adjusting some of the core systems to support more features in the future which took a bit longer than expected, but everything is still functioning as it should. Most of the changes are cosmetic, so I don't expect any major bugs. 

I'll have a new build up soon so testers can get access to the latest features!

Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: 0.6.0 - Exploration & Diplomacy Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This new update includes improvements to the exploration and diplomacy system.

I've added an encoded notes system that will contain journal entries from different characters. Each note is encrypted with a series of unique keys. Collect all of the keys to unlock the notes!

The diplomacy system includes passive quests that will give you unique rewards as well as a new UI for viewing and managing your relations.

You'll also see some minor bug fixes and adjustments, new items and more improvements to the planet generation algorithm.

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: 0.5.0 - Gamepad Support and More Items!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This update includes basic gamepad support and more items!

You'll find more crafting items, a fusion reactor and more modular weapons in this update!

Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: 0.4.1 - Recipe fixes
notes.notes:

The new items created a minor issue where some recipes were not working. 

This has been resolved and a patch will be up as soon as possible.

Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: 0.4.0 - Moar Buildings!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I've started the process of adding all of the building meshes to the game. This means that you will have the ability to recreate any structure that you see in the game!

There are hundreds of new parts already, giving you endless possibilities when it comes to making unique buildings!

I am still in the process of developing new methods for creating complex compounds and materials, so crafting recipes for the buildings will be relatively simple for now. 

I also went ahead and added all of the modular sword pieces to the item list. Now you have the ability to create thousands of unique swords using a few simple parts!

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: 0.3.0 - Chemistry!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I have now added the full periodic table of elements as collectible items. This means that most of the crafting recipes are going to be updated.

My plan is to make crafting as realistic as possible, so you will be seeing more build parts coming soon as well!

Stay tuned for the next update!

notes.title: Update 0.0.1 - Modular Weapons!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Thank you so much for the support and feedback! 

I'm preparing to release a small patch for the Day Zero's pre-release.

The update will include a new main menu map and fixes to the multiplayer loading screen.
